# Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy

> A comprehensive, peer-reviewed open-access scholarly database of philosophy topics maintained by Stanford University's Metaphysics Research Lab.

The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (SEP) is one of the most authoritative and widely-cited philosophy reference works, featuring entries on philosophers, philosophical movements, and core concepts written by expert contributors. The site is supported through a combination of institutional memberships, donations, and the Friends of the SEP Society, ensuring free public access to all content.

## Core Resources

- [Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy](https://plato.stanford.edu): Main entry point and homepage for the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy reference work.
- [About the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy](https://plato.stanford.edu/about.html): Overview of the Stanford Encyclopedia's publishing model, peer-review process, and mission.
- [Table of Contents](https://plato.stanford.edu/contents.html): Comprehensive table of contents and index directory for all philosophy topics in the encyclopedia.

## Navigation & Discovery

- [Chronological List of Published Entries](https://plato.stanford.edu/published.html): Chronological index of all published philosophy encyclopedia entries.
- [What's New](https://plato.stanford.edu/new.html): Recent updates, new entries, and article revisions with RSS feed for staying current.
- [Advanced Tools](https://plato.stanford.edu/tools): Search tools, browser plugins, and navigation guides for enhanced encyclopedia exploration.

## Editorial & Contribution

- [Editorial Information](https://plato.stanford.edu/info.html): Editorial policies, author guidelines, and submission guidelines for prospective contributors.
- [Editorial Board](https://plato.stanford.edu/board.html): List of editorial and subject editors leading the peer-review process for the philosophy encyclopedia.
- [How to Cite the SEP](https://plato.stanford.edu/cite.html): Citation guide and bibliographic format instructions for properly referencing encyclopedia entries.

## Support & Membership

- [Support the SEP](https://plato.stanford.edu/support): Funding appeal and membership information for supporting the open-access encyclopedia.
- [Become a Friend of the SEP](https://plato.stanford.edu/support/friends.html): Friends of the SEP membership program offering PDF access and exclusive benefits to entries.
- [Make a Donation](https://plato.stanford.edu/support/donate.html): Donation page for tax-deductible contributions to support the encyclopedia's mission.
- [SEPIA for Libraries](https://plato.stanford.edu/support/sepia.html): SEPIA library membership program for institutional open-access funding and consortium participation.

## Help & Information

- [Contact Information](https://plato.stanford.edu/contact.html): Contact details for the Metaphysics Research Lab and editorial staff.
- [Displaying Special Characters](https://plato.stanford.edu/special-characters.html): Technical guide for properly displaying special characters and symbols across operating systems.
- [Digital Accessibility](https://plato.stanford.edu/accessibility.html): Digital accessibility policy and compliance reporting for inclusive encyclopedia access.

## Optional

- [Archives](https://plato.stanford.edu/archives): Fixed edition archives and version history for citation reference and historical access.
- [Libraries/Consortia Supporting the SEP Financially](https://plato.stanford.edu/support/commitments.html): List of libraries and consortia providing financial support to ensure continued open access.
